_comment: Live smoke plan for the cnc-lab instance (5 XRd devices, SR-PCE provider cml-pce, credential profile cml-xrd). Read phase is side-effect free. Write phase creates smoke-* objects and removes them again (create -> verify -> delete), leaving the platform as found. Data Gateway steps target the embedded gateway: mapping 'remove' really unmaps but the embedded pool re-maps within ~2 s, and 'add' immediately after a remove succeeds (verified), so the write phase leaves mappings as found. NSO steps act on P2 only (check-sync, sync-from) and prove the zero-match and wildcard guards; sync-to and the inventory-wide sync are not run. Phase D (2026-09-15) appended the tier-1 write chains: device groups/rules, PM policy + retention, ZTP objects, external subscriptions (refusal diagnosis + clear-by-topic; the Kafka create chain needs an application-dispatch destination the lab lacks), alarm settings — each creates phase-d-* objects and removes them. SRv6 (2026-09-15) appended read steps (locators, dataplane, readiness) that answer 'no SRv6' on the SR-MPLS lab and dry-run-only provisioning steps; re-run after the SRv6 underlay is committed.
